heading: Wednesday, August 26, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Alibaba Qwen3.8-Flash / Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Zhipu AI GLM-5.3-Flash.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Flash and open-weight Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash is a lower-cost multimodal MoE model (125B parameters, 6B active), released alongside open weights for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, which Qwen describes as an experimental preview of the architecture for Qwen4. Alibaba says training cost is about one-ninth that of Qwen3.7-Plus.

items.headline: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3-Flash multimodal model
items.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash is an open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 320B total and 18B active parameters, native visual input and a hybrid attention architecture. Z.ai describes it as the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, targeting office-document and financial-research workflows.
